name: Chain Penitent
description: An armored prisoner who counts every blow as another broken vow. Two short chain lashes become harder to withstand the longer the fight lasts.

abilities.description: Makes 2 strikes per response. Plating and retaliation apply to each strike.
Gains 1 attack damage for each elapsed round; resets next combat.
